name: schnippo
description: __TAGLINE__: aus deinen Takes ein Rohschnitt per Chat, mit Ton, Zooms, B-Roll, Grafiken und Reels.
long_description: Lokaler MCP-Server: liest einen Ordner mit Takes ein, transkribiert mit Gladia (eigener API-Key), schlägt Takes und Schnitte vor und baut in DaVinci Resolve Studio (21.1+) nicht-destruktiv Timelines. Originalmaterial wird nie verändert. Voraussetzung: DaVinci Resolve Studio mit „External scripting using = Local“. DaVinci Resolve ist eine Marke von Blackmagic Design.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of your recordings, for example de or en.

format.title: Format
format.description: auto, reel, youtube, course or commercial. With auto, Schnippo detects the format.

export_folder.title: Export folder (optional)
export_folder.description: For exports and subtitles. Empty: next to your footage.

projects_folder.title: Default projects folder (optional)
projects_folder.description: Lets you use just the project name in chat.

update_check.title: Check for new versions
update_check.description: One request a day to GitHub, without your data.

sfx_folder.title: Your own sound effects (optional)
sfx_folder.description: Folder with your own sounds. Licensing is up to you.

freesound_api_key.title: Freesound API key (optional)
freesound_api_key.description: Searches sounds with a license filter (freesound.org/apiv2/apply).

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Generates sound effects from text, uses credits.
